title: Autorepairing VPC Terraform plugin: subnet profiles, endpoint mapper, canary upgrades and health probes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reusable Terraform module (and small operator) that codifies VPC topology patterns for Private deployments. The module must expose subnet profiles, NAT/IGW selection per subnet, VPC endpoint (interface + gateway) definitions, route table automation, and include built-in health probes and autorepair hooks to support safe rolling upgrades. The goal is to reduce bespoke infra code across customers and to provide safer upgrade paths for on-prem/VPC customers.
background: Customers deploying Redwood Private ask for a repeatable, auditable VPC pattern. Current deployments have drift, manual route fixes, and risky upgrade steps. We want a single module that enforces subnet roles (control-plane, inference, egress, management), picks appropriate egress (IGW for internet-facing subnets, NAT for private subnets), wires VPC endpoints for S3/Dynamo/SecretsManager, and surfaces health telemetry. Additionally, upgrades to the networking blueprint should support canary rollout and automatic remediation if probes detect failed routes or unreachable endpoints.
goals: Create terraform module with parametric subnet profiles and route table generation
Implement endpoint mapper that creates interface/gateway endpoints based on feature flags
Add health probes that validate route target reachability and endpoint DNS/IPs
Provide an optional operator (lightweight lambda/controller) for autorepair and canary rollback
Document runbook and upgrade safety checks for on-call and SREs
out_of_scope: Full-blown orchestration of cross-account peering and transit gateways. We will provide hooks but not implement global transit orchestration in this ticket.
design_notes: Subnet profiles are declarative maps: role, cidr_size, az_preference, nat_required. Route table generation will be deterministic with tags for controlled drift detection. Health probes run three checks: route resolution (table -> target), ICMP/TCP probe to known endpoints (e.g., S3 via VPC endpoint IPs), and endpoint DNS resolution. Autorepair actions are limited to: reattaching routes to a fallback target, recreating a missing endpoint resource, and creating a short-lived bypass route to IGW for emergency egress. Canary upgrades: apply change to single AZ subset, run probes for 10 minutes, then expand rollout. All repair actions must be audit-logged to CloudTrail/KMS-protected logs.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes subnet_profiles input and produces subnet, route_table, and route resources for each profile
Module supports toggles for creating interface and gateway endpoints; defaults to recommended endpoints for AWS regions
Health probe terraform plan and operator health-check lambda validate routing + endpoint reachability in staging
Canary upgrade flow documented and runnable: change applied to 1 AZ, probes pass, expand to remaining AZs
Autorepair operator performs a safe remediation in staging and writes an auditable event to the logging bucket; remediation rollbacks after failed repair attempts
Integration smoke tests in CI cover: subnet creation, endpoint toggles, route repair, and canary rollback
implementation_tasks: module: create module skeleton and inputs/outputs
module: implement route table tag and deterministic naming convention
module: add endpoint mapper with defaults per region
operator: implement probe lambda for route + endpoint checks
operator: implement autorepair actions with safety gates and backoff
tests: add terraform test harness and run in CI (staging account)
docs: runbook, upgrade playbook, and example usage for customers
risks: Autorepair could mask systemic issues if not properly gated
Incorrect route reattachment may create traffic loops in peered topologies
Operator IAM permissions need tight scoping; overly permissive roles are a compliance risk
Region-specific endpoint differences may produce unexpected drift
testing_plan: Create a dedicated staging VPC per CI run. Tests: 1) plan/apply the module with default profiles, 2) validate routes and endpoint objects exist, 3) simulate route deletion and assert operator repairs, 4) run canary upgrade by changing a single profile attribute and validate probes and rollback behavior. Add unit tests for the operator logic and terraform acceptance tests using Terratest.
rollout_plan: Start with internal staging: deploy to infra-staging account, run canary upgrade on one AZ. If stable for 72 hours, roll to customer-qa clusters (2 customers). After monitoring for 7 days, mark for GA in private-2025.03. Include an opt-in flag in Dedicated onboarding for customers to accept autorepair agent.
